decisions.reason: The modular extensions have not been visible since 2019, which suggests results below aspiration, so problemistic search favours moving their engineering resources back to the core plants and new ventures.

Although it has dropped from view, the waste-oil plant was the flagship closest to the core waste-to-energy business, so R&D slack and its strategic fit justify carrying it a while longer despite uncertain results.

Plastic-to-fuel was only thinly presented and has been absent for two years, signalling a persistent shortfall against aspirations, so releasing its resources for other technology ventures is the boundedly rational response.
